push.sectionSubtitle: What makes your phone buzz — and what can wait until tomorrow.
push.deviceIntro: A subscription belongs to ONE device, not to your account: every phone and every computer is enabled separately.
push.notConfigured: This server has no notification key yet, so nobody can receive them. Let the administrator know.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. Open Nexus in Chrome (Android, desktop) or in Safari (iPhone, iPad).
push.installNeeded: On iPhone and iPad, only the app added to the Home Screen receives notifications. Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, reopen Nexus from its icon and come back here.
push.activeHere: This device is enrolled: notifications arrive even when the app is closed.
push.denied: Notifications were denied for this site, and an app is not allowed to ask again. The permission is reset from the browser's own settings: the padlock in the address bar then “Notifications” on desktop, Settings ▸ Nexus ▸ Notifications on iPhone.
push.enableFailed: This device could not be enrolled
push.testSent: Test sent — it should arrive within seconds
push.testFailed: The test did not go out
push.forgotten: This device will no longer receive notifications
push.typesIntro: Everything is on by default. What you uncheck still appears in the bell: it simply stops buzzing the phone.
push.quietIntro: Nothing buzzes between these two times (Toronto time). Both fields empty: never quiet.
push.quietBypassHelp: Urgent means missed calls, new leads, and text messages waiting for a human. The rest — follow-ups, appointments, assignments — waits until quiet hours end.
push.quietInvalid: Give both a start AND an end time, and two different times.
push.mobileIntro: Your personal number, so your mobile rings at the same time as your line when a client calls.
push.mobileHelp: Stored encrypted: this screen only ever shows the last four digits. Clear the field to remove it.
push.mobileInvalid: This number cannot be dialled — ten digits, area code included.
push.ringMobile: Ring my mobile for incoming calls
push.ringFeatureOff: Simultaneous ring is not open for the team: until the administrator turns it on, this switch would do nothing.
push.ringLineOff: Simultaneous ring is open for the team, but not on your line yet. Ask the administrator to open it.

syntax.title: This file is not readable JSON.
syntax.hint: Most often: a trailing comma before a closing brace or bracket, a missing quote, or a comment — JSON does not allow those.

errorScreen.hint: This screen could not load. Most of the time the network dropped along the way: try again before looking any further.
errorScreen.notFoundHint: There is nothing at this address. The link may be stale, or the record is no longer there.
errorScreen.criticalHint: Nothing that was saved is lost. Reload; if this screen comes back, tell the administrator.

offline.title: No connection
offline.hint: This phone can no longer reach the network. Nexus needs to be online: records, calls and texts live on the server.
offline.reassure: Nothing is lost: it will all be there as soon as the connection is back.
offline.retryHint: If this screen comes back, the network is not back yet.

install.title: Install Nexus on this phone
install.why: Added to the home screen, the app opens without an address bar, keeps you signed in, and it is the only form that can alert you when you are not looking at it.
install.iosNoPush: Until Nexus is on the home screen, this iPhone will receive nothing: no missed call, no text, no new lead. This is not a setting to hunt for — on iPhone, notifications do not exist outside an installed app.
install.iosStep1: In Safari, tap the share button at the bottom of the screen.
install.iosStep2: Scroll through the list of actions, then tap this line.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”, then reopen Nexus from its new icon: that is where notifications can be offered to you.
install.iosSafari: Do this from Safari: the other browsers on iPhone do not always offer “Add to Home Screen”.
install.buttonHint: The browser will ask you to confirm.
install.noPrompt: The browser has not offered to install on this page yet. In the meantime, it is done from its menu:
install.declined: Installation cancelled. It is still available from the browser menu:
install.menuStep1: Open the browser menu, top right.
install.menuStep2: Tap “Install app” — or “Add to Home screen”, depending on the version.
install.androidThen: Then reopen Nexus from its new icon and allow notifications.
